title: Fixtures
description: The fixture ticker: a team-by-gameweek difficulty grid built from the model's own expected goals rather than FPL's static preseason FDR (DL-37). Covers the same gameweek window plan.json does, so the ticker and the plan cannot disagree about how far ahead 'ahead' is. Doubles and blanks come from the same fixture-counting the chip calendar uses, not from a second derivation of the same fact.

from_gameweek.description: First gameweek in the grid — the next one to be played.

to_gameweek.description: Last gameweek in the grid, inclusive. Clipped at the end of the season.

difficulty_scale.description: What a difficulty number means, published alongside the numbers so the reader can argue with the scale rather than take it on faith (DP-10).

minimum.description: Easiest possible score. Scores are clipped to this.

neutral.description: A fixture the model rates exactly league-average. Not a midpoint by convention — the arithmetic genuinely lands here for an average fixture.

maximum.description: Hardest possible score. Scores are clipped to this.

anchor_ratio.description: The tunable that sets the scale's steepness: a side expected to score this multiple of the league mean scores `minimum` for attack. Named and defaulted rather than buried as a literal (DP-06).

description.description: The formula in words, for a tooltip.

fixture_model.description: Which model produced these expectations, and its fitted parameters. A difficulty rating whose origin cannot be recovered is one nobody can challenge (DP-09).

league_mean_goals.description: Time-decayed mean goals per team per match. The denominator every ratio below is taken against.

home_advantage.description: Multiplier applied to the home side's expected goals.

teams_rated.description: How many clubs the model actually has ratings for. Zero means it fell back to league-average everywhere, which makes every fixture a 3 — visible degradation rather than silent (DP-15).

team_fixtures.description: One club's run over the window. The summary means are what 'sortable by run quality' sorts on.

mean_difficulty.description: Mean overall difficulty across the fixtures actually scheduled in the window. Blanks contribute nothing rather than counting as maximally hard — a blank is flagged separately so a view can penalise it on its own terms. Null when the club has no fixture at all in the window.

mean_attack_difficulty.description: As `mean_difficulty`, for the attacking half of the scale.

mean_defence_difficulty.description: As `mean_difficulty`, for the defensive half of the scale.

gameweeks.description: One entry per gameweek in the window, always present and always in ascending order — including the gameweeks this club blanks, which is exactly the entry that would otherwise be invisible.

fixture_gameweek.description: One club, one gameweek. A double is two fixtures here; a blank is none.

is_double.description: This club has two or more fixtures in this gameweek.

is_blank.description: This club has no fixture in this gameweek.

fixture_entry.description: One fixture, rated from the perspective of the club whose row it sits in.

opponent.description: Short club name of the opposition.

kickoff_utc.description: UTC. The browser renders local zones itself (DL-11). Null for a fixture with no confirmed time.

expected_goals_for.description: Goals the model expects this club to score. The derivation behind the difficulty score, published so the score is checkable (DP-09).

expected_goals_against.description: Goals the model expects this club to concede.

difficulty.description: Overall difficulty: the mean of the attacking and defensive scores. Lower is easier.

attack_difficulty.description: Difficulty for this club's attackers, from expected goals for. Published separately because a high-scoring game between two good sides is a good fixture for forwards and a bad one for defenders, and collapsing that into one number is most of what is wrong with a single FDR figure.

defence_difficulty.description: Difficulty for this club's defenders and goalkeeper, from expected goals against.
